completed_work.models: Typed Swift projection models mirroring E0 three-surface architecture and desktop projection schema. 17 surface states, all E0 privacy classes, evidence status vocabulary, capability admission states. All models are Codable and Sendable.
completed_work.fixtures: Comprehensive fixture data for all 5 product areas (Connect, Repository Estate, Project Studio, Inference Studio, Publish Preview) plus published Lane C provider evidence and identity. All fixtures carry isFixture=true and DEVELOPMENT_ONLY warnings.
completed_work.navigation_shell: NavigationSplitView sidebar with 5 tabs (Cmd+1 through Cmd+5). Sidebar includes provider evidence mini-section showing published Lane C data with integrity status. Fixture mode banner in footer.
completed_work.connect_view: Carte Blanche welcome view with 3 explanation cards (what Carte Blanche grants, private study vs. public publication, granted capabilities). Handles: ready, connecting, authorized, permissionBlocked states. Simulated connect flow.
completed_work.repository_estate_view: Repository listing with import status indicators, private/public counts, publication classification badges. Clone progress bar. Handles: empty (dedicated state), ready, importing, error, unauthorized states.
completed_work.project_studio_view: Investigation status display (turns, tool calls, phase), project understanding summary (language, ecosystem, architecture, modules), evidence rail (receipts, checkpoints, findings, corrupt events with explicit warnings), bootstrap proposals (draft/review states), public-safe profile candidate preview with withheld-field indicators. Handles: empty, inProgress (with ProgressView), draftReady, reviewRequired, corrupt/untrusted evidence warnings.
completed_work.inference_studio_view: Local runtime status (provider, model, VRAM, quantization, tok/s), capability admission cards with 6 statuses (admitted, refused, degraded, reviewRequired, unavailable, pendingEvaluation), draft suggestions with approval requirements, degraded/unavailable detail sections. Handles: unavailable, degraded, ready states.
completed_work.publish_preview_view: GitHub Pages readiness status, public-safe project page preview with section cards (title, content hash, privacy class, evidence status), explicit WITHHELD CONTENT section, NOT SAFE badge when publicSafeVerified=false, approval flow with approve/reject buttons. Handles: empty, reviewRequired, published, corrupt (NOT SAFE) states.
completed_work.shared_components: StatusBadgeView, SurfaceStateBannerView (17 states), FixtureModeBannerView, EvidenceStatusIndicator, SectionHeaderView, CardView, PrivacyBadgeView, DeferredServiceBannerView, FlowLayout.
completed_work.design_tokens: Liquid Glass-inspired color palette (accent, semantic status colors, material hierarchy), 7-font typography scale, progressive disclosure spacing rhythm (4-32pt), border radii.
completed_work.app_menu: Navigation menu with keyboard shortcuts, Demo menu for fixture simulation, Help menu.

released_boundary: GridlineAppShell v1: a native macOS operator UI that renders the connected-developer/project-studio journey from typed backend projections and emits governed user intents. The shell: consumes typed projection envelopes rather than domain ledgers, emits typed intents rather than triggering raw operations, displays canonical/derived/proposed/public-approved state distinctly, remains safe when integration services are not yet published by representing unavailable panels through typed fixture/deferred states, and allows later replacement of fixtures with live released projections without redesigning the view hierarchy.
stated_consumer_purpose: A developer can launch the macOS app, enter the Carte Blanche/repository/project workflow using real backend projections or clearly identified service-backed fixture mode, and inspect a project-page candidate without UI code bypassing domain authority.
deferred_seams: Live J0/K0/L0/M0 service wiring (lanes not yet published)
E1 transcript-derived design doctrine integration (E1 not yet released)
freeze_condition: A developer can launch the macOS app, enter the Carte Blanche/repository/project workflow using real backend projections or clearly identified service-backed fixture mode, and inspect a project-page candidate without UI code bypassing domain authority.

constraints.name: no_backend_authority_in_swiftui
constraints.detail: Zero hits for Process, NSTask, URLSession, git operations, GitHub API calls. FileManager limited to ResourceLocator (logs/docs exception). AgentLoop appears only as UI display text.

constraints.name: no_direct_github_operations
constraints.detail: Zero hits for oauth, token, credentials, keychain in Swift. GitHub references are display strings only.

constraints.name: no_direct_filesystem_mutations
constraints.detail: Zero hits for write, copyItem, moveItem, removeItem beyond ResourceLocator's createDirectory (logs).

constraints.name: no_domain_authority
constraints.detail: Zero hits for agent_loop, context_assembly, inference_admission, publication_policy, evidence_validation, capability_gating as Swift implementations. All terms appear only as UI labels.

constraints.name: fixture_data_clearly_marked
constraints.detail: All fixtures set isFixture=true. DEVELOPMENT_FIXTURE banner in all 5 views. Status message says 'Fixture mode. No live backend connected.' Intent dispatch marks '[FIXTURE — no backend]'.

constraints.name: all_surface_states_handled
constraints.detail: 17 surface states in enum with color/icon/label. Every view handles empty, loading, ready, blocked/refused, degraded, and corrupt/untrusted — either through explicit code paths or SurfaceStateBannerView fallback.

constraints.name: no_terminal_workflows
constraints.detail: Zero hits for Process, NSTask, shell execution, Terminal in any new Swift code.

sub_checks.name: publish_preview_no_private_content
sub_checks.detail: Withheld fields displayed as transparency indicators (count + 'N fields withheld'), not revealed. Public-safe verified badge displayed. No raw source/paths/secrets in preview.

sub_checks.name: project_studio_separation
sub_checks.detail: profileCandidate.isPublicSafe boolean controls display. Withheld fields listed by count. Private content separately listed as 'withheld during investigation'. Repository publication class displayed as PrivacyBadgeView.

strongest_falsifier_attempted: Can SwiftUI perform GitHub, filesystem, AgentLoop, context, inference, or publication authority actions directly? Result: FALSE. The SwiftUI code contains zero Process, NSTask, URLSession, git operation, GitHub API, shell execution, or domain logic implementations. All domain actions route through typed intents dispatched to the Python backend. The strongest falsifier failed.
